_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Checked into git so this repo always talks to the
Opportunity Outdoors accounts, never whichever account happens to be authorized
globally on the machine. Project scope beats user scope, so these override any
No credentials live here. Each server shells out to read its key from ./.env.local,
which is gitignored, so the config is shareable and the secrets stay local.
Required in .env.local: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN (a Supabase personal access token from
the account that owns project ffivubkouyqzvebuxflf) and RESEND_API_KEY.

args: if [ -f ./.env.local ]; then export SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN="$(grep -E '^SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=' ./.env.local | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//')"; fi; exec npx -y @supabase/mcp-server-supabase@latest --project-ref=ffivubkouyqzvebuxflf
if [ -f ./.env.local ]; then export RESEND_API_KEY="$(grep -E '^RESEND_API_KEY=' ./.env.local | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//')"; fi; exec npx -y resend-mcp
